studies_note: The installed r3 v6 data release is indexed by evidence group; r3_studies maps individual manuscript IDs and sections to those groups.

r3_studies.status: Paused development study. The final coordination test was not completed.

coverage_note: The manuscript IDs in r3_studies have installed data in the companion release identified by public_data_manifest_sha256. supplementary_research_sources is a separate index of public code and reports.
main_scope: The final Chinese and English r3 v6 main manuscripts, including their own figures, captions and Table 4-1, determine the scope of the data release. A listing in the supplementary catalogue alone does not qualify a study. The complete research-source catalogue below indexes public code and reports only.
